# The hub imports none of the packages it holds path helpers for, so each of
# them can import the hub without an import cycle.

muxt generate
muxt check
exec go build ./...
cd $WORK
exec go list -deps .
! stdout 'example.com/m/admin'
! stdout 'example.com/m/blog'
stdout 'example.com/m'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() []int { return []int{42} }
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}{{range .Result}}<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle .}}">article</a>{{end}}{{end}}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/article.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1><a href="{{.Path.Admin.Dashboard}}">admin</a>{{end}}
